in_sanskrit.name: चर्वी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who shines, illuminates, or makes things brilliant and radiant.

in_hindi.name: चर्वी
in_hindi.long_meaning: A watchman, sentinel, guard, or a young girl. Also, means beautiful, brilliant, and radiant.

in_tamil.name: சர்வி
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who receives grace, beauty, wealth, gem, or jewel. Also, means brilliant, radiant, and luminous.

in_telugu.name: చర్వి
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is radiant, luminous, or has the quality of being radiant and luminous. Also, means brilliance, splendor, and beauty.

in_marathi.name: Charvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy, Happiness, Radiance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'charu', which means 'beauty' or 'charm'. The suffix 'vi' means 'radiance' or 'shining'. This name represents the joy, happiness, and radiance that a newborn brings into the world.
